{{Quote|There isn't much in the data banks about the Helska system. There's not an easily inhabitable planet among the seven, and no one's taken the time or trouble to build one up. None of them even have names&mdash;just Helska 1 to 7.|[[Garth Breise]], to [[Danni Quee]]|<ref name="VP">''[[The New Jedi Order: Vector Prime]]''</ref>}}
The '''Helska system''' consisted of the star [[Helska system's star|Helska]] and seven planets. It was located along [[Vector Prime]].

The fourth planet, [[Helska IV]], was the site of the [[Yuuzhan Vong]]'s first foothold in the galaxy.
It was destroyed by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] shortly afterwards.
